ValidationRule.description: Description: Prevents users from selecting the same fund in both the Buyer and Seller fields to ensure that a Secondary Trade cannot occur between identical entities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Buyer__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Seller__c))), TEXT(Buyer__c) = TEXT(Seller__c), TEXT(Buyer__c) <> 'Syndicate/Investor' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Buyer and Seller cannot be the same fund or party.
